settings.heading: Try It Risk-Free
settings.text: We're confident you'll love it, but if it's not for you, no worries. Try it for 90 days, and if you're not completely satisfied, return it for a full refund — no questions asked.

settings.title: Turn It On
settings.text: Hold the on button for 3 seconds. We recommend using the device after applying your moisturiser and/or serum.

settings.title: Choose an LED & Mode
settings.text: Toggle between 7 LED light settings by pressing the on button. You can also choose between EMS, Clean & Heat modes.

settings.title: Start Massaging
settings.text: After picking a mode, start massaging your face as you would with a gua sha — gliding slowly from the centre outward.

settings.question: How long will it take to see results?
settings.answer: Most users start noticing visible improvements — firmer skin, a lifted appearance, and a healthy glow — within 3 to 4 weeks of consistent use. For best results, use for 5–10 minutes per session, 5–7 times a week. Pairing with our Vitamin C Serum or Hyaluronic Acid enhances results and absorption.

settings.question: What are the main benefits?
settings.answer: It combines Red Light Therapy for anti-aging, EMS for visible lifting and firming, Vibrating Massage to reduce puffiness, and Heat Therapy to boost circulation. With multiple LED modes targeting acne, dark spots, and uneven tone, it delivers professional-level skincare at home.

settings.question: How do I use this device?
settings.answer:
1. Apply your choice of skincare or moisturiser to your face.
2. Hold the power button to turn the device on.
3. Massage up and down your skin, as you would with a regular gua sha.
Use 1–2× per day for 5–10 minutes. We recommend starting with once per day at 5 minutes and building up gradually.

settings.question: How do I charge the device?
settings.answer: The device is simple to charge — just use the included USB cable. A full charge takes around 3 hours and lasts about 1 hour of use. Each mode turns off automatically after 5 minutes to conserve battery.

settings.question: Does the device hurt to use?
settings.answer: No. On EMS (electrical muscle stimulation) mode there may be a slight tingling sensation as the device stimulates your facial muscles — this helps firm and tone your face.

settings.question: Does it come with all 7 colours?
settings.answer: Yes — the device includes red, blue, green, cyan, white, purple and yellow light.

settings.question: Is it suitable for all skin types & tones?
settings.answer: Yes, this device is suitable for all skin types and tones, and can be used on both the face and neck by both women and men.

settings.question: Who is this device NOT suitable for?
settings.answer: Our LED face sculptor is not suitable for: individuals who have undergone facial surgery; individuals with subcutaneous metal implants; those who are pregnant or within the period of pregnancy.
